## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: hazardous driving conditions
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The work zone page says an added speeding penalty applies when a sign lists it, but prints no amount; no amount is stated here [A01].
The flood death share since the stated year is a statewide historical statistic kept as printed; it is not a rule [A04].
The flood water depths are introduced in the handbook as reports, so they are taught as approximate guidance rather than exact thresholds [A04].
The wildlife page includes conservation and anti-littering advice; only the driving actions and timing were turned into facts [A05].
The wildlife guidance continues on the next page, which belongs to the emergencies section; it is not taught here.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
